agent_authority_substrate.authority: qta_agent/authority.py :: the transition table and invariants I1-I6 that decide what may become canonical; qta_agent/events.py :: the append-only hash-chained log that is the only writable record of those decisions; qta_agent/evidence.py :: the content-addressed store that makes a cited digest resolvable, which is what turns I6 from a shape check into an existence check; qta_agent/canonical.py :: the one byte representation every digest in the layer is taken over
agent_authority_substrate.implementation: qta_agent/ -- canonical (serialization), events (log + separate head witness), authority (state machine), store (live projection, optimistic concurrency, idempotency), invalidation (transitive staleness derived from the transition table), reconstruct (a deliberately separate replay that re-authorizes every transition and is compared against the live projection), evidence (content-addressed, self-verifying, append-only)
consumers: tests/test_agent_substrate.py (transition table, log integrity, projection, invalidation, reconstruction)
tests/test_agent_substrate_properties.py (Hypothesis property and stateful testing; invariants asserted on every reachable state)
tests/test_agent_evidence.py (the store, and the gate wired to it)
agent_authority_substrate.does_not_mean: This layer governs how claims ABOUT the project become canonical. It does not govern, compute, or influence any physics. No module in qta_agent/ is imported by the solvers, by qta_full_sim.py, or by metrics.py; it cannot read or write any gate; PASS=0 is unaffected by anything it does. A record reaching PROMOTED here means a claim was proposed, independently verified, and promoted under a recorded policy -- it does not mean a gate passed, that anything was measured, or that hardware exists.
agent_authority_substrate.note: Enforcement is verified by mutation testing rather than by coverage: each check is deleted in turn and the suite must fail. Two matrices, both at 20/20 killed -- tools/mutations/agent_substrate.json (state machine, log, projection, invalidation, reconstruction) and tools/mutations/agent_evidence.json (evidence store and the gate wired to it) -- re-run with tools/mutation_matrix.py, which exits non-zero on a survivor, on an anchor that no longer matches its source, or on a source not restored byte-identically, and refuses to start against a red baseline. A surviving mutation means a check is unprotected, not that it is redundant. Narrative form: AGENT_SUBSTRATE.md.
agent_authority_substrate.status: BUILT_AND_VERIFIED_NO_PRODUCTION_CALLER: the substrate has no consumer outside its own test suites, and tests/test_agent_substrate_isolation.py enforces that by name (ALLOWED_IMPORTERS). Nothing has been promoted through it; no existing claim, gate, document, or output in this project has been re-derived under it. PROMOTED is a state this code reaches in its tests and nowhere else. Wiring it to a real workflow is a separate change that must name which claims it governs and who holds each role.
